key_insight: SRPO reframes multi-agent RL for LLMs by optimizing the smallest jointly consumed output set as one action, instead of updating responses separately.
engineering_relevance: This gives a unified training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed multi-agent workflows, making coordination more consistent across system designs.
method: Defines an active set as the minimal set of outputs used by one transition.
Combines member log-ratios into a cardinality-normalized set ratio and assigns one relative advantage.
Clips the entire set once to align optimization with the joint action actually executed.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons.
watch_item: Performance and stability may depend on how transitions are reduced into sets and on the chosen set sizes, so implementation details are critical.
paper_title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
